correctness.rationale: The exact rank-five EF type recursion is proved by standard induction. For a four-point cap the possible fifth-point collinearity patterns are six single-pair patterns, the empty pattern, and crossing matchings; no other multisets can occur. For orders at least five singletons and emptiness always occur by explicit line counts. The equations v=1, u=1, u+v=0 give precisely the field-characteristic crossing dichotomy and all crossing subsets in the stated regimes. For orders 2, 3 and 4, pure equality or affine-basis games, together with explicit low-dimensional separation strategies, establish the remaining cases. All nine types are pairwise distinct. Sampled exact five-round recursions over orders 2,3,4,5,7,8,9,11,16 agree; the infinite proof does not use sample extrapolation.

value.rationale: The natural point-collinearity reducts of affine spaces form an infinite two-parameter family. Exact rank-five theory detects both field-size thresholds and a subtler odd/even characteristic distinction, while in even fields of order at least eight it cannot detect affine dimension two versus greater dimension. The result provides a complete nine-class partition and a sharp 125-point representative. These are structural model-theoretic boundaries, not arbitrary finite invariants or routine recomputations.
